question: Why did Hardware revenue drop so sharply from Q2 to Q3 2025?
plan: Compare total Hardware revenue and order volume between Q2 2025 and Q3 2025 to confirm the magnitude of the drop and determine whether it was driven by fewer orders, lower quantities, or lower average prices.
Break down Q2 2025 versus Q3 2025 Hardware revenue by individual product to identify which specific products or subcategories experienced the largest sales declines.
Examine customer segments or sales channels for Hardware purchases in Q2 versus Q3 2025 to see if the drop was concentrated in specific regions or customer groups.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN 'Q2 2025' WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN 'Q3 2025' END AS quarter, SUM((oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS avg_net_unit_price FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Hardware' AND o.status = 'completed' AND ((o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30') OR (o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30')) GROUP BY quarter LIMIT 500

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q2_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q3_revenue, (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END)) AS revenue_change FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Hardware' AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue_change ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT c.segment, r.region_name, o.channel, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q2_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q3_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_change FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE p.category = 'Hardware' AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment, r.region_name, o.channel ORDER BY revenue_change ASC LIMIT 500

answer: Hardware revenue dropped sharply from $2,615,311.92 in Q2 2025 to $744,611.11 in Q3 2025 due to a steep decline in order volume and total quantities sold, dropping from 699 orders and 2,741 items to 238 orders and 778 items respectively, while average net unit prices remained relatively stable.
